title: Chirp
summary: CHIRP, verb intransitive Cherp. To make the noise of certain small birds, or of certain insects; as a chirping lark, or cricket. CHIRP, verb transitive To make cheerful. CHIRP, noun A particular voice

inlines.v: CHIRP, verb intransitive Cherp. To make the noise of certain small birds, or of certain insects; as a chirping lark, or cricket. CHIRP, verb transitive To make cheerful. CHIRP, noun A particular voice of certain birds or insects.
